#!/bin/bash
# BOBnet Morning Briefing - Daily 7:00 AM briefing for Bob
# This script runs via cron at 7:00 AM daily

WORKSPACE="/home/bob/.openclaw/workspace"
BRIEFING_DIR="$WORKSPACE/briefings"
DATE=$(date +%Y-%m-%d)
TIME=$(date +%H:%M)

cd "$WORKSPACE"

# Ensure briefing directory exists
mkdir -p "$BRIEFING_DIR"

BRIEFING_FILE="$BRIEFING_DIR/briefing-$DATE.md"

echo "=== Generating Morning Briefing for $DATE at $TIME ==="

# Start the briefing markdown file
cat > "$BRIEFING_FILE" << EOF
# Morn
